posts.author: HoloM
posts.content_md:
Hello, 

I wonder if I can put in an additional cable between the analog controller and the 315m?

I want to put the controller in a housing and want to mount the plug for the 315m on the outside of the new housing.

I thought I would take about 30cm of flat band ribbon cable with male plug on one and female plug on the other end to make this possible.

Something like this, but with 25 pins:

![Image](http://cache.smarthome.com/images/12836d.jpg)

Do you think this is possible and may work?

Or do you expect any problems?

Thanks

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md: Since this is not a high speed digital connection and unlikely to be high current, I think 30 cm should be fine. You might want to confirm (by probing the existing cable with a VOM) that the connections are truly 1 to 1 and that they are not swapping pins inside the connectors. But if you are adding this to the existing cable as an extension rather than replacing it entirely it would not matter.
